title: Figure 5: hypothetical gravitational bias drive surface plots
description: Two 3D mesh surface plots of a distorted scalar potential, each with a small cross-section line sketch above: "a) Multiplicative modification, B, Eq. (39a)" and "b) Exponential modification, b, Eq. (39b)." Captioned "Figure 5. Hypothetical Gravitational Bias Drive." The text explains these represent asymmetric modification of Newton's gravitational constant to induce gradients that accelerate a vehicle, taken from the Frontiers book.
